title: Virtual-table constraint collation, IN, and RHS inspection

scope.rationale: These three xBestIndex-only APIs inspect one planner constraint. PlanningContext now preserves resolved collations, IN classification and handling flags, and lazy cached RHS values instead of returning unconditional stubs.

external_source_responsibilities: Typed resolver folds one RHS expression
dependencies.caller_closure: All three source API bodies are assigned; exported APIs recover PlanningContext and invoke these helpers during xBestIndex.

inputs: Live PlanningContext, constraint ordinal, IN handling mode, and RHS output
outputs: Collation, IN status/mask update, or RHS value and SQLite result
contracts.ownership: Planner retains collation and RHS ownership.
contracts.state_and_results: Valid absent collation becomes BINARY. IN query/set/clear follows negative/positive/zero handle. Invalid RHS ordinal is MISUSE; absent/null RHS is NOTFOUND; resolver errors propagate; success is cached.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O or locks; RHS may invoke one typed resolver.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: RHS output is null on failure; invalid inputs do not mutate masks.

representation_differences: Explicit PlanningContext fields replace private HiddenIndexInfo adjacency.
A typed resolver abstracts sqlite3ValueFromExpr while preserving lazy cache and result behavior.

oracle.protocol: Use two constraints to exercise explicit/default/invalid collation, IN query/set/clear, and cached/lazy/null/invalid RHS.
oracle.normalization: Compare exact strings, masks, pointers, and primary result codes.

assurance.oom: Resolver failures propagate with null output.
assurance.malformed_input: Context and ordinal validation preserve output/state.
assurance.continuation: RHS cache avoids repeated folding; IN mask remains mutable during callback.
assurance.performance: Constant-time lookup plus at most one lazy fold per slot.

integration.production_owner: src/core/sql_frontend.zig PlanningContext and exported vtab APIs
integration.native_call_path: compileVirtualScan invokes xBestIndex with embedded IndexInfo; module callbacks invoke exports.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Unconditional BINARY, false-IN, and NOTFOUND-RHS stubs are retired.

independent_review.notes: Needs nonzero-constraint compiler integration, pinned-C trace, assurance, and review.

known_blockers: Populate metadata from bounded SELECT constraint compilation.

implementation_spans: upstream where.c complete three API bodies and surrounding HiddenIndexInfo/planner use
native PlanningContext, xBestIndex invocation, and exports
callees: Resolved planner metadata and lazy RHS resolver
assertions_branches_cleanup: Ordinal bounds, IN bit updates, null output, lazy cache, and result propagation assigned
